overview_description.description:
Oort Digital provides outsourced NFT utilities and experiences for both brands and their users.

With Oort Digital, brands can easily create their own custom NFTs, create campaigns to reward the NFTs to their users and allow the NFTs to plug into our own gamified experience. This allows brands to increase engagement and boost loyalty with their users. For NFT owners and players, Oort Digital provides a one-stop place to earn, stake, lend, borrow, trade, and play with your NFTs.

We’re here to help brands better engage with their users by unlocking the full potential of their NFTs. By leveraging our in-house NFT utility and experiences, we can help brands deepen their relationships with their users and create new opportunities for engagement and loyalty.

product.name: NFT Creation and Campaigns
product.description: Oort Digital enables brands to create custom NFTs and launch campaigns to distribute these NFTs to users, integrating them into a gamified experience.

product.name: NFT Marketplace
product.description: A platform for users to earn, stake, lend, borrow, trade, and play with NFTs, facilitating a comprehensive NFT economy.

product.name: Gamified NFT Experiences
product.description: Users can engage in battles using custom-branded hero NFTs, enhancing the gaming experience with owned digital assets.

product.name: NFT Borrowing and Lending
product.description: Facilitates the borrowing and lending of NFTs among users, allowing NFT owners to earn passive income and borrowers to access NFTs at a lower cost.

product.name: Clan Creation
product.description: Users can create their own Clan with custom branding, including logos and colors, to build a community within the platform.

product.name: Community Engagement Tools
product.description: Tools for clan leaders to add members to their clan, either from an existing community or by attracting new members through offers.
